issue.title: Use sans-serif headings in built-in themes
issue.description:
Correct the built-in Theme v3 presets so Heading uses the sans-serif font family by default in both Default and Quiet Editorial.

Background:
During the Theme v3 migration, the legacy serif stack was mapped into the new semantic Heading role. That deterministic migration preserved data, but it produced an undesirable built-in preset result: the Default theme now renders semantic headings with the serif stack.

This ticket is a built-in theme preset correction, not a typography-system redesign.

Owner direction:

Default theme:

* Heading font -> Sans-serif
* Body font -> Sans-serif
* Mono font -> Monospace

Quiet Editorial theme:

* Heading font -> Sans-serif
* Body font -> Sans-serif
* Mono font -> Monospace

Preserve the existing Theme v3 semantic model:

* Heading remains a first-class semantic typography role.
* Body remains a first-class semantic typography role.
* Mono remains separate.
* Users may still freely choose any supported family for Heading or Body.

Preserve existing typography values unless current accepted theme fixtures already intentionally differ:

* Heading weight: 600
* Body weight: 400
* Existing Heading/Body tracking values
* Existing Mono stack
* Font size and line-height remain component-owned

Scope:

* Built-in Default theme fixture
* Built-in Quiet Editorial theme fixture
* Any deterministic built-in theme normalization/tests required to keep the presets canonical

Do not:

* change the Theme v3 schema;
* change migration rules for arbitrary existing user themes;
* change setFontFamily/setFontWeight/setTracking mutation semantics;
* change type-heading/type-body utilities;
* change Workbench typography control behavior;
* remove serif as an available font option;
* make one-off component overrides.

Acceptance:

* Default built-in theme loads with Heading = Sans-serif, Body = Sans-serif, Mono = Monospace.
* Quiet Editorial built-in theme loads with Heading = Sans-serif, Body = Sans-serif, Mono = Monospace.
* Heading weight remains 600 unless an existing accepted preset explicitly specifies otherwise.
* Body weight remains 400 unless an existing accepted preset explicitly specifies otherwise.
* Existing tracking values remain unchanged.
* Users can still select serif for Heading manually.
* No regression to theme import/export, persistence, migration, history/recovery, Design Command, or semantic typography rendering.
* Tests document the corrected built-in preset values.
